Name: (CHD) Vile's HD Portraits for Change Dialogue Plus
Author: Gizzlembos03
Description:
This content pack allow VIle's HD portraits to show up on Change Dialogue Plus config.


-- Install --

1. You need this mod and all its requirements

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]Change Dialogues plus SVE - CFD - LfL - Razolyn (Spanish and English) - Robin
Romance Mod (English) - Jodi Datable - True Love Valley and Farmerjack's
Dialogue Expansions[/url]

2. Download and install as any other content pack (put zip contents in the mods folder)

- You dont need to install Vile's HD or Jier's HD (as it is required for Vile's) for this to work, the images are included in the mod (with permission from the author). Think of this as an alternate install method if you are using Change Dialogues plus instead of other mod to replace bachelors.

All credits go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47743198]VileBeggar[/url] for his/her portraits, i only changed the name of the images.
